newsitem.title: USA: Riviera postpones common stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Riviera postpones common stock offer.

text.p: Riviera Holdings Corp said Monday it postponed its proposed underwritten public offering of common shares "because of market conditions."
It said that in the meantime, it is looking into alternative financing for the construction of a casino in Black Hawk, Colo.

In October, the company said it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the offering of up to 3.0 million common shares, including 1.5 million shares to be sold by three stockholders.
